items.title: HUD condition polarity pills and +N overflow popover
items.do: On Aveline, apply at least 4 active conditions/effects (mix buffs like Empowered / Shield of Faith and debuffs like Prone, Daunted, Hindered), then select Aveline's token and click the +N button on the HUD conditions row.
items.expect: Debuffs (including Daunted) show downward debuff styling, buffs show upward buff styling, and past 3 items a +N ▾ button opens a clean popover grouped into Debuffs, Buffs, and Other (clickable to open the Effect).

items.title: HUD Situational tab count badge and Urgent vs. Available split
items.do: Make Aveline Prone (Available situational item), then trigger a Reaction or map prompt (e.g. Judge damage reduction or Snap Shot on Sylwen) while viewing Hands/Macros.
items.expect: The Situational tab shows a count badge, auto-switches cleanly when an urgent Reaction or prompt arrives (highlighting gold), and places urgent prompts above passive options (Prone / Granted) separated by a hairline.

items.title: Roll dialog Net Boons/Banes badge, cap, and Favored/Doomed cancel
items.do: With Sylwen targeting the Orc Warrior, open Basic Attack. Add 3 Field Boons (or 2+ named Boons of the same name), add a Bane to inspect the Net badge, then toggle both Favored and Doomed on at the same time.
items.expect: The header shows a colored Net +N / Net −N / Net 0 badge (hiding at ±5 when Favored/Doomed takes over). Any named Boon/Bane past the 2-cap shows a dashed strikethrough and a small "cap" badge. Active Favored and Doomed together both show dashed strikethrough as cancelled.

items.title: Chat card damage modifier strip, post-Apply tags, and dark theme polish
items.do: With Aveline (Longsword) targeting an Orc Warrior (give it Resist Slash 2 or Empowered), roll Basic Attack (Tier 2 or 3, and try a Critical) and apply damage. Check both light and Foundry dark theme.
items.expect: Under the rolled damage pool, a compact modifier strip lists contributing modifiers (Weapon / Flat / Empowered). After Apply, Resist / Weak / Immune show as compact readable tags after "Took". Critical boxes/labels and 5-Boon/5-Bane tags look crisp in both light and dark themes.
